description: Why isn't my x402 API in the Bazaar? Listing lint checks an x402 endpoint for Bazaar indexing: one unpaid call validates its 402 PAYMENT-REQUIRED header, discovery metadata, input and output schemas, description limits and service name against the indexing rules, with a fix for each problem and the fixed 402 ready to paste, graded as the weekly report card would grade it. Also lints A2A agent cards. Use when an agent needs to lint an x402 listing or A2A agent card before its first sale. Price: $0.01 in USDC per call, paid with x402 inside the tool call. Or send a Skyfire pay or kya-pay token in the kyapay-token header (or in this tool's kyapay-token argument), and this tool charges $0.01 to it. Failed calls aren't charged.

kyapay-token.description: A Skyfire pay or kya-pay token made for Agoranome's service, from a client that can't set the kyapay-token header. Leave it out when paying with x402 or the header.

url.description: Public https URL of the paid endpoint, or of an A2A agent card (/.well-known/agent-card.json)
